automationNotes: Steps mirror the document exactly — https://www.contentstack.com/docs/administration/change-organization-role-of-existing-users. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated. Doc describes navigating via App Switcher > Administration > Users tab, then vertical ellipsis > Edit on a user row, updating roles on the Edit User screen, then Update — this replaces the old 'Org Admin icon / Settings page' navigation, which 404'd under the previous source URL. Edit works on the first row on the default page (no pagination needed). Clicking 'Edit' immediately after the ⋮ menu opens was landing before the menu's click handler was fully wired, so an explicit hover step is inserted before the click to mimic natural mouse pacing — without it, the click registers (menu closes) but nothing navigates. The Update button is left verified-but-unclicked at the end since no field was actually changed, so it stays disabled — clicking it isn't meaningful without a real edit. The real Edit User screen only lists product rows the user actually has (e.g. just CMS + Administration, no Assets row for a fresh user) — the CMS/Administration verify steps below match doc step 3's bullets for whichever rows are present.
